lure: A loving friend needs a small help

message.subject: A small help, my dear
message.body: My dear, I need a small help. Invest $2,000 in crypto with me and we will build our future together.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Be careful: love that asks for money.
reasons: The messages built affection and secrecy before the ask.
A crypto investment with a friend met online is the romance scam.
